purpose: Three new whole male portraits for visual review only; no active asset installation

reference_roles.role: edit target; project master skin, material, robe and fixed composition
secondary approved style/skin evidence; hairstyle and identity not reused

specs.name: 露额高束·清峻英气
specs.design:
Handsome energetic adult age26, composed confidence rather than anger. Medium-density brows with slightly raised angular outer thirds and clean fine tapered tails, visible individual hairs. Long clean open eyes with a gently lifted outer flow, narrow natural inner lid, bright restrained brown irises; keep normal male small eye aperture. A straight finely modeled nose with a firm softly squared tip, naturally thin lips with a quiet level seam and restrained warm closed expression. This must read as a distinct face from both reference identities.
HAIR: a completely OPEN FOREHEAD with softly swept-UP roots, several irregular lifted soft waves traveling backward into a modest HIGH tied long ponytail/half-knot held with a plain dark cloth band. The frontal hairline remains natural and subtly uneven, not a slick lacquered V. BOTH temples, cheek sides and chest are OPEN, with NO long bilateral face-framing locks; only tiny short flyaways near temples. Narrow flowing ponytail falls behind the neck and shoulders; no horizontal hairpin, crown, thick headband or huge top bun. Preserve dark matte fine project strands, no silver rim. Clearly different from existing center-part bun and unbound side-parted loose hair.
specs.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / original character variant for a modular Chinese cultivation game.
Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET and our approved PROJECT MASTER: preserve its exact 1024x1536 canvas, straight-frontal body pose, head/neck outer frame, robe, embroidery, collar, waist sash, backdrop, lighting and PAINT MATERIALS. Image 2 is a SECOND user-approved project portrait: secondary evidence of the same warm skin palette, fine soft hair material and attractive understated face rendering. Do not copy Image2's loose side-parted hair or facial identity.
Change ONLY the hairstyle and the INTERNAL eyebrow/eye/nose/lip design to create ONE clearly different handsome adult Chinese male. Paint the whole face and hair harmoniously in one finished illustration; do not visibly paste components.
PALETTE/STYLE LOCK: exact approved warm light ivory-peach skin on face/ears/neck, deep warm charcoal-black matte hair with fine softly separated strands and weak warmgray highlights, delicate semi-realistic Chinese gongbi and soft ink-and-wash finish. Keep natural subtle skin texture, refined soft pigment edges. No white/gray/silver hair, no tan/bleached pink skin, no manga/cel outline, photorealistic pores, glossy 3D polish, hard makeup or heavy eyelashes. Keep the same muted jade-green robe, pale gold botanical/cloud embroidery, ivory inner collar and warm ivory paper background.
FACE/FRAME LOCK: strictly frontal gaze toward viewer, no turn or tilt. Same rounded skull, ears, jaw outline, connected neck and exact head/body scale. Center about x513, eye centers around (462,365)/(567,365), brow band y340–350, nose base around(517,444), lip line around(516,477), chin around(513,544); shoulders around y718, tied sash around y1250. The positions are guides to maintain the existing compatible frame, not marks to draw. Do not enlarge the face, shift it higher, lower the ears, lengthen neck or change collar opening.
Eyes stay SMALL-TO-MEDIUM ADULT MALE SIZE. Normal restrained brown irises partly covered by the upper lid, sparse short lashes, fine lightly painted lids. Vary eye contour and brow morphology rather than eye/iris size. No doll eyes, round staring eyes, very narrow angry slits, heavy black eyeliner, heavy eyelid shadow, pouting/glossy lips or moustache.
Hair should have naturally varied wisps and strand lengths, never a perfectly clean helmet, straight bowl/齐刘海 or Dora haircut. Never default to two matching long strands dangling beside both cheeks and across both sides of the chest. Clearly readable new silhouette with normal restrained hair volume.
OUTPUT: exactly ONE complete full-canvas 1024x1536 portrait, frontal head-to-tied-waist framing like Image1. No panels, comparative sheet, labels, text, diagrams, UI, reference images, weapons, added jewelry or props.

The frontal hairline remains natural and subtly uneven, not a slick lacquered V. BOTH temples, cheek sides and chest are OPEN, with NO long bilateral face-framing locks; only tiny short flyaways near temples. Clearly different from existing center-part bun and unbound side-parted loose hair.

specs.name: 碎额微束·清朗少年
specs.design:
Handsome adult age23, clean youthful alertness but mature natural proportions. Brows slightly shorter, soft shallow arch and finer density, with a relaxed open inner spacing. Softly almond-shaped eyes with a subtly rounder upper-lid arc and calm level outer corners, normal small male eye opening and normal irises, never baby-like large eyes. Nose softly straight with a slightly rounder tip; natural fine lips with a light asymmetric near-smile, no lipstick or pout. Face identity must differ visibly from the straight-angular-brow hero and both references.
HAIR: broken SHORT FOREHEAD WISPS arranged as three or four airy unequal locks from an irregular off-center root. They end at several DIFFERENT heights on the UPPER/MIDDLE forehead, well ABOVE BOTH eyebrows; gaps expose plenty of skin. Do not make side-swept eye-length bangs, rigid triangular spikes, an even short fringe row or bowl cut. Side hair is lightly gathered behind both ears, not two cheek curtains. A modest LOW half-tie and slim long back hair behind shoulders, fastened with a plain dark tie; the front collar and BOTH sides of the chest remain clear. Small lived-in wisps, restrained volume, fine warm charcoal project material.

specs.name: 偏分长辫·沉静疏朗
specs.design:
Handsome adult age29, scholarly, calm and quietly strong. Distinct long rather level sparse brows, no sharply raised sword peaks, softly tapered inner and outer ends. Long almond eyes with a low relaxed upper lid and very slight downward outer-corner flow, still clear awake gaze, normal brown iris size. A subtly broader softly straight nose and more softly rounded alae, naturally thin slightly wider closed lips with an almost straight gentle seam. No angry/drooping tired expression, aged wrinkles, heavy under-eye shadows, feminine lashes or glossy mouth. Distinguish his whole face from the youthful short-fringe variant and the high-tie hero.
HAIR: one soft deep SIDE PART and a broad shallow curving wave crossing the UPPER forehead, ending in hair tucked BEHIND one ear; both pupils and brows stay visible. The opposite temple stays open. Gather the long hair into ONE loose thick tapered BRAID resting over the IMAGE-RIGHT SHOULDER and down ONE side of the chest, with a few naturally escaping fine hairs. The opposite cheek and chest remain completely open. No paired cheek-dangling strands, top bun, pin, crown, headband or two braids. Braid uses only plain dark cloth ties, soft flexible natural overlapping hair texture and the same dark matte fine-strand pigment; not a plastic rope or silver outlined plait. Keep the robe/pose unchanged.
